verdict.rationale: Appwrite serves a live llms.txt at its root, verified by a probe returning HTTP 200 with agent-targeted content. It also serves docs.md, which points to a full nested documentation llms.txt, and every docs page is available as raw Markdown by appending .md. Agent-oriented Skills Markdown files, a Copy page button, and an MCP server that exposes the docs round this out, so first-party documentation is backed by independent hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Use Appwrite when a coding agent is writing an app that needs auth, databases, storage, functions, or host
For the full nested page index, see the documentation llms.txt.
You can access any documentation page as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to the URL.
Skills are open-source Markdown files that give AI agents deep knowledge of Appwrite SDKs and services.
Every page in the Appwrite documentation includes a **Copy page** button that copies the entire page content as Markdown to your clipboard.
